app.title: {{bar}} Work Schedule
app.offline: You are offline. Showing the schedule as it was last loaded; changes can't be saved.
app.noPages: Your account has no pages yet. Ask an admin to add you to a group.

login.title: Work Schedule
login.forgotHint: Enter the email of your account. We'll send you a link to choose a new password.
login.resetSent: If an account has this email, we've sent it a link to choose a new password. The link works for one hour.

common.error: Something went wrong, please try again

weekStatus.notPublished: This week's schedule hasn't been published yet.
weekStatus.unlockConfirm: Unlock this week for changes? Employees keep seeing the locked version until you lock the week again.
weekStatus.clickHint: Click an empty spot in a day to add a shift.

schedule.viewOnly: View only: ask a manager to change shifts.

shiftForm.chooseDaysHint: Click days in the calendar to choose them.
shiftForm.afterMidnightHint: Times after midnight belong to the evening before: a Friday shift 20:00–02:00 ends at 02:00 on Saturday.
shiftForm.chooseDay: Choose at least one bar day
shiftForm.endAfterStart: The shift must end after it starts (the bar day runs from opening to closing)

employees.title: Employees ({{count}})
employees.removeConfirmWithLogin_one: Remove {{name}}? This deletes their login account and {{count}} shift.
employees.removeConfirmWithLogin_other: Remove {{name}}? This deletes their login account and {{count}} shifts.
employees.addHint: The employee is added to the schedule as a waiter straight away, so you can plan their shifts. They get an invitation to choose their own password.
employees.logoutWarning: Saving a new password logs {{name}} out on all devices.
employees.inviteSent: Added {{name}}. An invitation was sent to {{email}}.
employees.inviteLinkText: This server can't send email, so send this invitation link to {{name}} yourself, e.g. as a text message:
employees.inviteLinkHint: The link works for 7 days and only once.

account.name: Name
account.usernameRule: 3-32 characters: letters, numbers, dot, dash or underscore
account.passwordHint: At least {{count}} characters. Give it to the person securely.
account.emailOptional: Email (optional, for logging in and password reset)

barSettings.title: Bar settings
barSettings.name: Bar name
barSettings.hint: Times are shown in the bar's timezone for everyone. When the bar closes after midnight, shifts after midnight belong to the evening before. Pick a fairly dark accent colour: buttons show white text on it.

admin.managerHint: The manager is also added to the schedule with the role manager, so shifts can be planned for them.
admin.removeManagerConfirm: Remove manager {{name}} ({{username}})? Their login account is deleted.
admin.lastManager: A bar needs at least one manager
admin.employeesNote: Employees' accounts are shown for reference; only managers are managed here.
admin.deleteWarning: Permanently deletes {{name}} with all its employees, shifts and user accounts. This cannot be undone.
admin.deleteConfirmLabel: Type the bar name to confirm

links.inviteWelcome: Hi {{name}}, you've been added to the work schedule of {{bar}}. Choose a password to see your shifts.
links.resetDone: Your password has been changed. You can now log in with it.

signup.title: Create your bar's schedule
signup.intro: Set up your bar in a minute. You can invite your staff right after.
signup.name: Your name
signup.changeLater: You can change these later in the bar settings.
signup.botCheck: Please wait for the security check to finish.
signup.haveAccount: Already have an account? Log in

verify.title: Confirm your email
verify.done: Thank you, your email address is confirmed.
verify.banner: Please confirm your email address: we sent a link to {{email}}. You can invite staff once it's confirmed.
verify.resent: A new link was sent to {{email}}.

onboarding.title: Get your bar started
onboarding.allDone: All set! Your staff can see their shifts.
onboarding.lock: Lock the week, so staff can see it

billing.title: Billing
billing.incomplete: Choose a plan and give your card to start the 30-day free trial. Nothing is charged until the trial ends.
billing.trialEnds: Your free trial ends on {{date}}. After that your card is charged automatically.
billing.trialEndsCancelled: Your free trial ends on {{date}}, and the subscription is cancelled then.
billing.endsOn: Your subscription is cancelled and ends on {{date}}.
billing.pastDue: The last payment failed. Stripe will try again; please update your card in Manage billing.
billing.readOnly: The subscription has ended, so the schedule is read-only. It will be locked on {{lockDate}} and its data deleted on {{deletionDate}}. Subscribe again to keep using it.
billing.locked: The subscription has ended and the schedule is locked. Its data will be deleted on {{deletionDate}}. Subscribe again to get it back.

interval.year: Yearly: €{{price}} per bar a year (two months free)

billing.trialHint_one: 30 days free, then charged for {{count}} bar. Cancel any time.
billing.trialHint_other: 30 days free, then charged for {{count}} bars. Cancel any time.
billing.vatNote: Payments are handled by Stripe. VAT is added according to your country; businesses in other EU countries can give their VAT number.
billing.returnSuccess: Thank you! Your subscription is set up.
billing.returnWaiting: Thank you! Your subscription is being set up…
billing.returnCancelled: Checkout was cancelled; nothing was charged.

past_due.owner: The last payment failed. Please update your card so the schedule stays editable.
past_due.staff: There's a problem with this bar's payment. The owner has been told.

read_only.owner: The subscription has ended, so the schedule is read-only.
read_only.staff: The schedule is read-only for now. The owner has been told.

banner.inactive: This bar's subscription isn't active, so the schedule can't be shown. Please ask the bar's owner.

support.title: Support mode
support.hint: See {{name}} as its managers do, read-only, for up to an hour. The reason is saved in the audit log.
